capture_format: interleaved signed int32 little-endian L,R; values are sign-extended 24-bit XP SDOC/OUT1 words
wav_format: 24-bit integer PCM, same sample values, no gain, resampling, limiter or analog model
reset: new Sc88Pro instance, upstream factory-reset sequence enabled, then 256000 boot frames captured separately
frame_zero: first renderSample after the constructor's factory-reset/power-cycle; no prefix discarded from boot.pcm
event_time: case-relative native frame, submitted before renderSample; firmware MIDI mailbox still imposes its original wire delay

roms.name: sc88pro_control.bin
roms.byte_order: H8 CPU order or recognized pair-swapped dump, normalize only in memory

comparison: exact bytes for repeated raw PCM and deterministic state; empty, truncated and changed samples must fail
silence_basis: No-MIDI SDOC/OUT1 is constant +32 per channel. The loaded XP program includes CRAM immediate +32 instructions at slots 121,135,237,252 (read back only after capture); xp_dsp_naive.cpp function 15 defines the immediate addition. Preserve all raw values, including this DC offset, with exact comparison.
coverage_limit: Preset sustain/filter/effect cases establish full-board reference outputs. Internal loop and filter state coverage is completed in Phase 1/2; no silicon-equivalence claim.
